notablePrerequisites: You have at least one additional card in hand.
description:
Cast Beck by paying {G}{U}.
Activate Scuttletide by paying {1} and discarding a card, creating a 0/3 Crab creature token.
When the Crab enters the battlefield, Beck triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Crab, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.
